text:
Which statement about the structure of an atom is correct?
A
Negative electrons surround a neutral nucleus.
B
Negative electrons surround a positive nucleus.
C
Positive electrons surround a neutral nucleus.
D
Positive electrons surround a negative nucleus.

options.label: A
options.text: Negative electrons surround a neutral nucleus.

options.label: B
options.text: Negative electrons surround a positive nucleus.

options.label: C
options.text: Positive electrons surround a neutral nucleus.

options.label: D
options.text: Positive electrons surround a negative nucleus.
